season.source: Tide and stream: NOAA STOFS-2D-Global (Surge and Tide Operational Forecast System, ADCIRC), the nowcast for each hour. Wind and gusts: NOAA HRRR 3 km analyses, one an hour. Both from NOAA Open Data on AWS.

forecast.source: Wind: HRRR 06z cycle of 19 Jul 2025. Tide: STOFS-2D-GLOBAL 12z cycle, its forecast at the mesh node nearest Los Angeles (Outer Harbor). Both as issued.

terrain.source: Terrarium elevation tiles (Mapzen, AWS Open Data). The island from zoom 13, on a 32 m grid.

image.source: Sentinel-2 L2A true colour, 22 August 2025 (Copernicus, from the AWS open-data registry).

wind.note: HRRR 10 m wind in tenths of a metre per second, blowing toward east (u) and north (v), and surface gust speed (g).

tide.note: Water level in metres above the model datum, close to mean sea level.
